title: Astro Portal session event payload: device_parked
description: A park the person asked of a smart telescope in mode expérimental: `requested` — the command was sent; `refused` — the device refused it. Never done by the application on its own. Recorded by the application from the driver's own code path with the night's clock; every field but the ones marked required is optional, and a reader tolerates a payload without them. Private in a shared night. See session-events.md.

reason.description: Optional, with `outcome: refused`: a short machine code of the cause (`below_horizon`, `parked`, `not_aligned`, `zenith`…), never a sentence.

family.description: Optional: the smart telescope's family (`seestar`, `dwarf`, `vespera`, `origin`) when the device is one.
